messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front and back reference views to match the hairstyle shape accurately. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first action change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then raises a right arm to touch the face and head before lowering it and standing still again.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from behind at roughly waist height, keeping the figure centered.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a light-blue graphic on the back, light-blue shorts with white trim, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled up into a high bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered person with a slim build and dark skin, seen mostly from behind.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing teal rings on the left, and a white building with blue-lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair changed from a short cropped style to a dark updo/bun with visible volume and texture at the back, while the person, clothing, scene, camera, and action remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, using front and back references, while keeping identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects unchanged.
uncertain: The exact match to the reference hairstyle is uncertain because the person is mostly seen from behind and the reference shows a more textured, layered updo with front framing that cannot be fully verified.
unexpected_changes: Output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, showing less of the top of the scene and a visible black band at the bottom in some frames.
